505.author: HongyeZhou
505.body:
## Problem
In `apps/desktop` SSE `pump`, frame `data:` is `JSON.parse`d without try/catch. A single malformed frame ends the stream and drops the live run UI even when the server may still be running.

## Expected
A bad frame is skipped or counted, the pump continues (or one toast surfaces), and the run still reaches a terminal/handled state when the server finishes.

## Verification cases

1. **Malformed mid-stream frame**
   - **Preconditions:** Desktop workbench connected; a run is in flight with an open SSE stream.
   - **Steps:**
     1. Inject one malformed `data:` line mid-stream (invalid JSON).
     2. Observe UI and subsequent frames.
   - **Expected / pass:** Pump does not abort solely due to that frame; user sees at most one clear error/toast; later valid frames or a terminal settle still apply.

2. **Clean stream still works**
   - **Preconditions:** Same as (1), no injection.
   - **Steps:** Complete a normal turn end-to-end.
   - **Expected / pass:** Transcript, terminal status, and settle behave as today (no regression).

## Context
Follow-up from review of https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/pull/499 (foundation). Out of that PR's Act-on scope; code-review inference on `api/stream.ts` pump.
505.title: desktop: harden SSE frame JSON.parse so one bad frame does not end the run stream

506.author: HongyeZhou
506.body:
## Problem
Desktop workspace upload sends `File.name` into FormData without client-side basename sanitization. Path escape remains a server responsibility (`readWorkspaceFile` notes this), but a crafted name such as `../outside.txt` or a name containing `/` should be rejected or renamed on the client as defense in depth.

## Expected
Before upload, the client strips path segments / rejects unsafe names so only a basename reaches FormData; server still remains the authority and continues to rename/reject escapes.

## Verification cases

1. **Crafted relative name**
   - **Preconditions:** Open session with workspace panel; upload enabled (session not archived).
   - **Steps:**
     1. Upload (or simulate) a `File` whose `name` is `../outside.txt`.
     2. Inspect the FormData filename and the resulting workspace listing.
   - **Expected / pass:** Client does not send `../outside.txt` as-is (sanitize/reject); server listing shows no escape outside the session workspace.

2. **Name with slash**
   - **Preconditions:** Same as (1).
   - **Steps:** Upload a `File` whose `name` contains `/` (e.g. `a/b.txt`).
   - **Expected / pass:** Client basename-only or reject; no nested path created via the client name alone.

3. **Normal basename unchanged**
   - **Preconditions:** Same as (1).
   - **Steps:** Upload `notes.md`.
   - **Expected / pass:** File appears under the session workspace with the expected name (rename-on-conflict still applies).

## Context
Follow-up from review of https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/pull/501. Non-blocking; server-side path authority noted in-PR.
506.title: desktop: sanitize upload File.name basename before FormData (defense in depth)

507.author: HongyeZhou
507.body:
## Problem
Settings › Runtime remote host credentials are write-only (good): empty fields keep the stored secret. The register/update API already accepts `password` / `passphrase` / `privateKeyPath: null` to forget, but the desktop UI never sends null, so there is no way to clear stored credentials from the dialog.

## Expected
A clear/forget control (or equivalent) sends null for the chosen secret fields so `hasPassword` / `hasPrivateKey` clear and later probes fail until a new secret is set.

## Verification cases

1. **Empty save keeps secret (current)**
   - **Preconditions:** Remote host with a stored password (`hasPassword` true).
   - **Steps:** Open credentials; leave password empty; save.
   - **Expected / pass:** `hasPassword` remains true (keep-on-empty behavior preserved).

2. **Explicit forget**
   - **Preconditions:** Same host with stored password.
   - **Steps:** Use the clear/forget control; save; re-open credentials / probe connect.
   - **Expected / pass:** `hasPassword` false; probe fails without a new secret.

3. **Re-set after forget**
   - **Preconditions:** Credentials cleared per (2).
   - **Steps:** Enter a new password; save; probe.
   - **Expected / pass:** `hasPassword` true; probe succeeds with the new secret.

## Context
Follow-up from review of https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/pull/502. Out of Act-on scope for that PR (Escape stacking is in-scope there).
507.title: desktop: UI to clear stored remote Runner credentials (API already accepts null)

511.author: sciencediscovery-bot[bot]
511.body:
跟进 #510（`fix(web): distinguish untitled session labels`，Closes #497）检视时发现的两处显示口径问题。它们是 `session-title.ts` 实现本身带来的，不是 #510 引入的新回归，因此没有作为合入门槛，单独记在这里。

## 现状
`apps/web/src/session-title.ts` 的 `sessionDisplayTitle()`：
- 候选集由调用方传入，`App.tsx` 默认传 `artifactSessions` = `listSessions(projectId, "all")`，**含已归档**；
- 序号按 `createdAt` 升序（`id` 兜底）编号。

而侧栏渲染的是 `sessions`，即 `listSessions(projectId, sessionListState)` 的子集，且**按 `updatedAt` 降序**（`services/api/src/store.ts:2787`）。

## 两个具体表现
1. **编号引用不可见的兄弟**：同一 Project 有两条未命名会话、其中一条归档后，活动列表只剩一条，却显示「未命名会话 2」，用户找不到 1（归档视图同理）。
2. **编号顺序与列表顺序可能相反**：较早创建的那条先有了活动（`updatedAt` 变大）后，侧栏从上到下会是「未命名会话 2」「1」。

## 可选方向
- A：编号按**当前渲染的列表**算（把可见子集传进 `sessionDisplayTitle`），归档视图各自编号；
- B：编号按整个 Project 算（保持现状），但排序键改成与列表一致（`updatedAt` 降序），至少让顺序读起来自洽。

两者都只是显示层改动，不动 `UNTITLED_SESSION_TITLE` 哨兵。最终取哪种属产品/UX 选择，需要维护者定。
511.title: web 侧未命名会话序号：候选范围与排序口径需要对齐列表

514.author: zhaozhaozz
514.body:
## Problem

Daily real-research shards fail during dependency preparation on the current `ubuntu-latest` image (Ubuntu 26.04, CPython 3.14.4), before any model calls. `.ci/prepare-real-research.sh` creates a venv using the runner interpreter and installs `numpy==2.2.6` and `scipy==1.15.3`. These versions fall back to source builds; SciPy then fails with `ERROR: Dependency "OpenBLAS" not found (tried pkg-config and cmake)`.

The same main commit (`7ee6c1d0bcc8374062364d51b3f4dfdf87a1396d`) passed dependency preparation on Ubuntu 24.04 / Python 3.12.3 on October 20 and failed on Ubuntu 26.04 / Python 3.14.4 on October 21. The October 22 and 23 scheduled runs repeat this failure. Current main (`0b74e53b`) still has the same numerical dependency pins.

Evidence: [October 21 run](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/actions/runs/39666641312), [October 23 run](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/actions/runs/40014929958).

## Required behavior

Support the new Ubuntu image and Python 3.14 rather than downgrading the runner or interpreter. Update the benchmark dependency preparation to a compatible, reproducible dependency set and check its direct consumers.

## Acceptance criteria

- The benchmark numerical dependencies install successfully on Ubuntu 26.04 / Python 3.14 without an accidental source-build requirement for the obsolete pins.
- DRB and Biomni benchmark preparation and evaluator imports remain compatible with the selected dependencies.
- Add focused validation that catches this compatibility failure without making model calls.
- Keep the real-case assertions and evidence requirements intact. Model gateway billing failures and previously fixed runner cleanup behavior are outside this change.
514.title: fix(ci): support real-research prerequisites on Ubuntu 26.04 and Python 3.14

519.author: zhaozhaozz
519.body:
## 范围与证据

汇总 [2026-10-24 Nightly run 40121906605](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/actions/runs/40121906605) 的三项剩余问题。运行版本：`9eb45d753b86b94ce67d41032d9511d724c628be`。

#514 / #515 修复的 Ubuntu 26.04 / Python 3.14 依赖准备已通过，本次不再作为阻塞项。以下区分实际运行结果与源码诊断，不据此认定所有 main CI 都失败。

## 1. real research-8 的会话标题断言未跟随显示规则更新

[失败 job 120955308760](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/actions/runs/40121906605/job/120955308760) 已实际执行该用例，在点击 Add session 后失败：

- [`issue-67-34-inline-cards.spec.ts:221`](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/blob/9eb45d753b86b94ce67d41032d9511d724c628be/test/issue-67-34-inline-cards.spec.ts#L219-L228) 期望 `Untitled session`，实际为 `Untitled session 2`。
- #510 已合入同一 Project 多个未命名会话显示序号的行为，实际标题与该规则一致。当前证据支持“测试期望过时”，不能据此认定产品的计划/子任务功能损坏。
- 此前的计划、follow-up、reload 断言已通过；失败后的切回原会话及位置保持断言尚未执行，不能算通过。
- #511 仍讨论编号集合与排序的 UX 口径，本 issue 不替它决定方案，只修复测试对已实现显示规则的错误假设。

## 2. 已执行失败的分片被汇总成 NOT_RUN

[research-8 结果 artifact 12574909042](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/actions/runs/40121906605/artifacts/12574909042) 的 `e2e-real/tagged/summary.json` 明确记录：

- planned=1、executed=1、passed=0、failed=1；
- 该身份的 `outcome=FAIL`。

但 [汇总 job 120992446082](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/actions/runs/40121906605/job/120992446082) 输出 executed=18/19、passed=18，并将该用例标为 `NOT_RUN`。

源码诊断：[`.ci/real-report.mjs:19-24`](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/blob/9eb45d753b86b94ce67d41032d9511d724c628be/.ci/real-report.mjs#L19-L24) 在失败分片的 `results.push(...summary.results)` 之前抛出 `SHARD_FAILED`，丢掉了其已执行结果。需要保留身份、版本、digest 等校验通过的失败证据，同时继续让 gate 失败。该运行应准确呈现 19 executed、18 passed、1 failed，而不是将执行失败混同为未运行。

## 3. 两项 UT 等待完成超时，原因待查

[UT job 120955273894](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/actions/runs/40121906605/job/120955273894)：4754 planned / 4754 executed / 4752 passed / 2 failed / 0 skipped。

[UT artifact 12572160563](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/actions/runs/40121906605/artifacts/12572160563) 中的实际失败：

- `ut/tagged/group-279/worker-1-events.jsonl`：`services/api/src/evolution/orchestrator.test.ts` 的 `a measured run is staged before the sidecar is asked to start`，报 `timed out waiting for the run to settle`。
- `ut/tagged/group-343/worker-1-events.jsonl`：`services/api/src/server.test.ts` 的 `running sessions accept queued runs and start them after the active run completes`，报等待 run 进入 `completed` 超时。

[同一 SHA 较早的 UT job 120785725594](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/actions/runs/40064771478/job/120785725594) 在 Ubuntu 26.04 上 4754/4754 通过。现有证据不能区分测试时序、环境或产品状态推进问题，不认定为负载抖动或确定性回归。

## 验收标准

- [ ] 会话切换测试按当前显示规则及明确的 Session 身份校验，补齐“新增会话 → 切回原会话 → 原计划/时间线位置保持”的验证；不删除原行为断言。
- [ ] 为汇总器补充“分片实际执行但失败”的无模型回归测试，保留 executed/failed 计数和失败身份；身份不匹配、缺失、重复、跳过等情况仍不得放行。
- [ ] 使用上述已有结果验证汇总应为 19 executed / 18 passed / 1 failed，退出码仍非零；不通过跳过失败分片把 gate 改绿。
- [ ] 分别定位两项 UT 超时，保留最后运行状态及相关事件等诊断证据，补充针对性回归验证；仅延长超时或重跑成功不能作为已定位的证据。

本 issue 基于已有日志、artifact 与源码核对，未触发新的付费模型调用或 CI 重跑。
519.title: bug(ci): 修复 Nightly 会话标题断言与失败分片统计，排查两项 UT 超时

538.author: HongyeZhou
538.body:
## Problem

PR #534 copies a redacted diagnostic to the clipboard and pre-fills a **public** GitHub new-issue URL. Token/secret/Bearer/URL-userinfo redaction is covered, but absolute filesystem paths that embed a username (for example `/home/<user>/...`, `/Users/<user>/...`, `C:\Users\<user>\...`) can still appear in the error title/detail and therefore in the clipboard and the draft URL. That leaks local identity/PII to a public tracker without the user noticing.

This is adjacent to #58 / #534 but was not part of the listed Security acceptance bullets (Authorization/Bearer, token, secret, password, cookie, URL userinfo).

## Expected

Before truncation and before building the GitHub issue URL, diagnostic text (and any exported log metadata strings) must redact home-directory / username path segments so a public draft cannot carry the local account name. Other redaction already required by #58 stays in place.

## Verification cases

1. **Unix home path in error detail**
   - Preconditions: Web UI shows a visible error whose detail contains `/home/alice/.sciencediscovery-data/logs/api.log` (or equivalent fixture).
   - Steps: Click **Copy key diagnostics**; open the GitHub issue draft from the same control.
   - Expected / pass: Clipboard and issue-draft body contain a redacted path form (for example `/home/[REDACTED]/...` or equivalent); the literal username `alice` does not appear. Bundle stays within the existing 4000 / 6500 caps.

2. **macOS / Windows user path**
   - Preconditions: Error detail contains `/Users/bob/project/file.ts` and `C:\Users\bob\AppData\...`.
   - Steps: Copy diagnostics and open the issue draft.
   - Expected / pass: `bob` does not appear in clipboard or draft URL/body; redaction markers are present.

3. **Negative — non-home path retained**
   - Preconditions: Error detail contains a non-user path such as `/tmp/sciencediscovery-test/out.log` or `/var/log/...` with no username segment.
   - Steps: Copy diagnostics.
   - Expected / pass: Path remains useful for maintainers (not over-redacted into uselessness); still no tokens/secrets.

4. **Regression — existing secret redaction**
   - Preconditions: Detail includes `Bearer sk-testsecret` and `api_key=private-value`.
   - Steps: Copy + open issue draft.
   - Expected / pass: Secrets remain `[REDACTED]`; path redaction does not disable prior rules.

## Context

Refs #534 (feat: copy sanitized error diagnostics). Related #58. Security hardening for the public GitHub draft destination.
538.title: Redact home-directory and username path segments in error diagnostic bundles

541.author: zhaozhaozz
541.body:
## Problem

After a remote Shell Execution is accepted, a lost status observation is recorded in two places that disagree.

The shell execution record becomes `unknown` / `unconfirmed`. That means the remote result has not been confirmed. It does not mean the command failed. Inspecting that execution reconciles the record with the Runner by the same Execution ID and does not resubmit the command (see #185).

The provenance execution run written when that observation throws is different. The dispatch error path appends an execution run with `status: "failed"`, `exitCode: null`, and stderr set to the observation error. `ExecutionRun.status` only allows `succeeded`, `failed`, and `cancelled`. Runs are append-only, so a later reconciliation that adopts the Runner's committed result updates the shell execution record and leaves this run unchanged.

Skill distillation and the memory graph read execution runs. They can treat an unconfirmed observation as a job failure, and they still see that failure after the shell execution record has been reconciled to the Runner's real outcome.

## Expected

- An observation that stays unconfirmed is not reported as a successful job or as a failed job by the execution-run record, by skill distillation, or by the memory graph.
- If reconciliation later adopts a committed Runner result for that same Execution ID, those readers see that result.
- A Runner outcome that really failed or was cancelled, including a non-zero exit or a recorded failure with a committed version, is still stored as failed or cancelled.
- The command is not replayed.

## Note

#185 does not choose how to represent an unconfirmed run. `ExecutionRun.status` has no value for "not confirmed", and the run list is append-only. This issue tracks that choice. It is separate from the shell-execution reconciliation fix.
541.title: [Bug] An unconfirmed shell observation is stored as a failed execution run
